Adjacent driver: the whole AI power chain 'from the grid down to the rack of the server' has many voltage step-down/conversion stages needing filtering and ripple-current management, driving strong growth in film capacitors and aluminum electrolytic capacitors plus the magnetics (inductors) and connector lines - embedded across computing, industrial and telecom segments. In notebooks, new tantalum packaging offering higher capacitance in a smaller package positions a laptop recovery as more of a 2027 story.
